description: Bulk move issues to a new status via a workflow transition. Get available transition ids via get_issue_transitions. Statuses like "closed" may require a resolution in values.

confirm.description: Set to true to confirm this destructive/bulk operation

issues.description: List of issue keys/ids OR a Tracker query-language filter string, e.g. "Queue: TREK Assignee: user1" (max 10000 issues per operation)

notify.description: Notify users about the change (default false)

values.description: Fields to set with the transition, e.g. {"resolution": "fixed"}

name: bulk_transition_issues
